svg.title: 33 · FDC / MainProgram/WH_SiteBindings
svg.text: ADDED · Receive source-controller facts before furnace programs run.
ADDED · More than one selected/stamped part is ambiguous; never pick the last scanned position.
ADDED · The selected part requires one unambiguous 50 MN or 300 MN destination.
ADDED · Reject multiple accepted wash returns across the two-furnace scan.
ADDED · Release the sole accepted return only after checking both furnace passes.
ADDED · Begin the next accepted-return scan.
ADDED · Commit the candidate only after both furnace Pre dispatches have been scanned.
ADDED · Freeze the selected part/load identity before the legacy item can be moved or cleared.
